answer.title: Automate CRM Lead Creation from Quote Request Emails
answer.trigger: An email arrives with a subject line indicating a new quote request.
steps: Receive the incoming quote request email.
Extract the customer details and job description from the email body.
Format the extracted information into a new lead profile.
Create the new lead in the CRM system.
answer.ai_help: AI extracts the customer name, location, and service requested from the email text to map directly into the CRM fields.
answer.risk_reason: If the automation fails, a lead might be missed or have a typo, but no money or customer-facing commitments are changed automatically.
